name: TC-893: Lima — a combo with 2 of the same item that has options is ONE '2 × <item>' step with a Customize row per unit — customising Burger 2 leaves Burger 1 on its defaults, an Add with Burger 2's required options missing is refused, and the quote carries one line per unit
description: Spec §13 on template-lima. Combo @ $30 = 2 × Lima Units Burger ($10, optional 'Bacon' +$1.50) + 2 × Lima Units Melt ($8, REQUIRED 'Sauce': Ranch $0 / Chipotle +$0.75); the backend stores four quantity-1 rows. The builder shows two steps: '2 × <burger>' ✓ Included and '2 × <melt>' Required, each with two unit rows (deal-step-unit: '<item> 1', '<item> 2', 'Included', own button 'Customize <item> n' / 'Choose options for <item> n'). Customising Burger 2 with Bacon: row 2 shows 'Bacon' + '+$1.50', row 1 stays 'Included' with no options. Melt 1 → Ranch, then Add → refused: alert 'Choose options for <melt> 2', focus on that unit's button, nothing added. Melt 2 → Chipotle → bar $32.25 → one Add. The checkout /quote carries one orderDeals item per DealItem row (each its own dealItemId) with upchargeAmount 0 / 1.50 (burgers) and 0 / 0.75 (melts); the server answers upcharge 2.25, lineTotal 32.25; the summary shows Items $30.00, Upgrades +$2.25 (Bacon, Chipotle) and Subtotal = the quote's.
